thread:
maria: Heads up — observed a failed canary rollback on prod-rt-1, deploy bot returned 403 during rollback attempt. Not sure if this is RBAC or KMS-related.
deploy-bot: [ALERT] 2026-02-15T09:12:34Z deploy rollback failed: HTTP 403 Forbidden (service-account:infra-canary-sa) : permission denied to 'canary.rollback'
ashley: ugh. we shipped the RBAC refactor last night (roles -> role_groups). did we migrate service account bindings for infra-canary-sa?
samir: I ran the migration on staging only. I thought infra migration ran in prod too but will check.
jon: quick check: `gcloud iam policies get-binding` shows infra-canary-sa no longer has the legacy `canary.operator` role — it has `ops.basic` only. that explains the 403.
maria: why would that affect rollback now? rollback path uses a KMS-signed attestation token and the rollback controller checks `canary.rollback` explicitly.
ashley: the refactor replaced explicit role names with group-based predicates for human principals, but service accounts were supposed to get explicit bindings via the migration script. looks like infra-canary-sa was skipped because it matched the old name pattern `infra-canary-*` and our regex filter excluded that cluster. :facepalm:
samir: confirmed. migration job logs show `skipped 1 principal: infra-canary-sa` at 02:14Z.
audit-bot: [AUDIT] 2026-02-15T02:14:00Z migration-job: skipped_principals=["infra-canary-sa"] reason="pattern_exclusion"
maria: also noticed KMS key rotation happened at 03:00Z. could that have invalidated rollback attestation?
jon: rollback flow: controller fetches signed token from KMS using key version referenced in `rollout.meta`. if the key version rotates, older signatures should still verify if we keep older public key material in the verifier cache. our verifier cache TTL is 7d. the rotation alone shouldn't cause a 403. this is pure authz denial before KMS call.
ashley: so root cause = RBAC migration skipped infra-canary-sa. secondary issue = missing audit trail for canary toggle operations in last 24h (we only have control plane event, no authz decision log).
samir: I can roll a hotfix: reapply `roles/canary.operator` to infra-canary-sa in prod, and re-run migration with the corrected regex. will need approval from ops leads.
maria: please do. also add an immediate mitigator: add a fallback binding for `group:canary-managers@redwood` to the canary rollback controller so humans can trigger rollback while infra SA is being fixed. make it expire in 24h.
jon: one more gotcha — the rollback controller caches effective bindings for 5m. after rebind it may take ~5m to take effect.
ashley: scheduling hotfix now. tagging @samir to apply. I will open a paged approval in #eng-oncall for audit sign-off.
samir: applying binding now: `gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member=serviceAccount:infra-canary-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/canary.operator`
samir: done. returns `ETag` update.
deploy-bot: [INFO] 2026-02-15T09:18:12Z policy updated for infra-canary-sa
maria: testing manual rollback trigger now.
deploy-bot: [INFO] 2026-02-15T09:20:03Z rollback started by user: ashley (via fallback) — canary id c-9931
deploy-bot: [INFO] 2026-02-15T09:20:45Z rollback completed successfully in 32s
ashley: confirmed rollback succeeded, traffic shifted back. :thumbsup:
audit-bot: [AUDIT] 2026-02-15T09:20:03Z authz_decision: principal=ashley action=canary.rollback result=ALLOW reason="fallback-group-binding"
audit-bot: [AUDIT] 2026-02-15T09:20:45Z rollout.event: canary=c-9931 action=rollback initiator=ashley status=success
maria: follow-ups: 1) fix migration regex and re-run against prod principals; 2) add preflight check that verifies all service accounts referenced by controllers have required roles (fail deploy if missing); 3) extend authz audit retention for canary operations to 90d; 4) add an e2e test that simulates KMS rotation + RBAC drift to verify rollback path.
samir: I'll take #1 and #2. ETA for re-run and preflight PR: today EOD.
ashley: I'll own #3, coordinate with compliance for retention policy.
jon: I'll write the e2e harness for #4 — need a test key rotation workflow in staging.
maria: also add a one-time migration audit: list of principals that were skipped + manual verification log. include it in the incident timeline.
ashley: filing incident ticket INC-2026-0215 and attaching logs. assigning remediation tasks.
maria: thanks team. turning this into a postmortem once actions are complete.
jon: small suggestion: add an automated smoke check post-migration that attempts a dry-run rollback authorization for each controller principal. saves future surprises.
samir: agreed. will include in the migration job.
maria: closing loop — prod rollback validated, hotfix applied, follow-ups assigned. leaving thread open for postmortem notes.
